title: Terminal — shell emulator with live passthrough
description: A React-DOM terminal: monospace glass aesthetic, colored prompt, arrow-key history, red stderr. A built-in command set (ls·cd·pwd·cat·mkdir·touch·rm·mv·cp·echo·whoami·date·uname·df·ps·neofetch·help·clear) runs against an in-memory FsModel, so it works with ZERO backend. Wire configureTerminal({ mode:"live", fs, exec }) and ls/cat read through your real filesystem, file mutations mirror to it, and any unknown command passes through exec.run as a one-shot shell call (stdout/stderr/exit rendered). Self-contained: shell inspector hooks are inert seams in lib/host.ts.
